verses.pali: … “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhā paṭiviratā; atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhā appaṭiviratā …pe….
verses.english: “… the sentient beings who refrain from injuring plants and seeds are few, while those who don’t refrain are many. …”
